name: guardrails
description: Containment policy for agentic sessions, built on Claude Code's OS-level sandbox rather than around it. Ships a sandbox-policy skill (settings keys, scope rules that silently ignore misplaced keys, four validated policy templates, failure modes), /guardrails-setup to generate and install a policy this repo's build actually survives, and /guardrails-doctor to check what is enforced rather than what is configured. Three hooks cover the gaps the sandbox leaves: credential shapes in outbound MCP and WebFetch payloads, both ways a Bash call leaves the sandbox (the dangerouslyDisableSandbox flag, and an excludedCommands segment that exempts the whole call), an audit log carrying both attempts and deny verdicts, and an opt-in Stop gate that refuses to let an agent finish on a red build.
